registered_before: any resident timing execution or inspection of real timing outcomes; current development uses source review and synthetic tests only
scope: descriptive matched quality/cost analysis of completed supplementary_all timing only

quality.other_round: verify identical retained output and observed scores; report every delivery/scoring failure separately; never replace round0 by the better or successful round
quality.primary_risk_level: gamma=2; CE within each trained seed over source/view/scenario, then mean across trained seeds
quality.raw_utility: unchanged primary or secondary observer utility, assessed separately on actual resident outputs
quality.proxy_net_utility: raw utility minus 0.002 times the known committed non-stop continuation path length
quality.main128_source_quality: retained separately; do not substitute these eight-source estimates or pool them with the primary three-view run

cost.sampling_unit: crossed training seed and source pair, preserving every view/scenario/round/condition within each sampled source block

failure_handling.observed_generation_exception: retain actual timing and the previously registered raw utility=-1, joint_loss=1, success=0, completion=0 execution-failure penalties; these are not measured semantic scores
failure_handling.unknown_action_path: proxy net utility unobserved; do not invent an action count or impute zero cost
failure_handling.offline_observer_exception: that observer score remains unobserved; physical output completion remains observed; no replacement with zero or another observer
failure_handling.missing_metric: no available-case risk or confidence interval; the affected paired metric is unavailable until its complete balanced census exists
failure_handling.priced_curve_eligibility: both compared conditions require every round to have successful generation, complete observed raw scores for that observer, and identical round outputs/scores; otherwise no priced curve is reported, while all costs and canonical quality/failure diagnostics remain retained

price_sensitivity.interpretation: arbitrary fixed preference scenarios, not calibrated human utility, a recommended price, energy use, dollars, or a conversion of the 0.002 action proxy
price_sensitivity.priced_outcome: raw actual utility minus lambda times actual full resident wall_ms; do not also subtract the 0.002 proxy in this alternate objective
price_sensitivity.random_cost: keep each realized wall_ms paired with its source/view/scenario/round and inside exp(-gamma*(U-lambda*wall_ms)); average exponentials within each trained seed, then average seed CEs
price_sensitivity.repeated_quality: canonical round0 utility may be paired with both observed timing rounds only after output/score replay consistency and completeness checks
price_sensitivity.not_equivalent_to: CE(U) minus lambda times mean wall_ms when timing is random
price_sensitivity.threshold_reporting: report every grid point and strict adjacent point-estimate sign-change brackets; no claim of a unique break-even threshold or unobserved crossings

comparisons: the main analysis non-oracle contrasts whose two conditions occur in the timing census; all are descriptive
